'''Mulatan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> located in the [[Mulatan system/Legends|Mulatan system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' area in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It was connected to the [[Gos Hutta system/Legends|Gos Hutta]] and [[Sleheyron system/Legends|Sleheyron systems]] by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Pabol Hutta/Legends|''Pabol Hutta'']].<ref name="TEA" />

Mulatan was a guardian world<ref name="LoNH" /> that served as a gateway into the ''Bootana Hutta'', which contained the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworlds]] of the [[Kajidic/Legends|clans]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Mulatan was dedicated to the defense of those worlds,<ref name="TEA" /> and a number of Hutt [[Warship/Legends|warships]],<ref name="LoNH" /> a rare sight elsewhere in Hutt Space,<ref name="TEA" /> always surrounded Mulatan,<ref name="LoNH" /> with [[Outlander|outsiders]] being advised not to linger there.<ref name="TEA" /> Mulatan was also regularly patrolled by the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Troonol]], a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Hutt [[Qunaalac]] clan.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mulatan was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-10.<ref name="TEA" /> It was subsequently described as a world the [[2015]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', published for use with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] system.<ref name="LoNH" />
